CustomField.description: Data quality score measuring key fields: Close Date in the past, Next Step Due Dates in the past, Opportunity Source, Last Activities, and Opportunity Owner
CustomField.formula: IF( RecordType.Name = "Pre-Opp" , 100 , IF( IsClosed , 100 , IF(CloseDate >= TODAY() , 20 , 0) + IF( Next_Step_Due_Date__c >= TODAY() , 20 , 0) + IF( !ISBLANK ( TEXT( Opportunity_Source__c )) , 20 , 0 ) + IF( AND( TODAY() - LastActivityDate < 30, !ISBLANK (LastActivityDate)) , 20 , 0) + IF( Owner.Profile.Name = "Account Exec" , 20 , 0) ))
CustomField.label: test
